brief: A 3x3x3 Rubik's cube, solved, drawn deterministically rather than generated. Orthographic-leaning three-quarter view at the app's own resting pose -- Ry(-45) then Rx(+24) -- showing the U face on top, F on the screen left and R on the screen right. Nine evenly sized square stickers on each visible face, each inset 6 percent of its cubie within near-black graphite plastic, with a hairline of pure black between cubies. Colours are the app's Cardinal palette put through the app's own value ramp in linear light, so the tile is a portrait of the cube the app renders: Chalk on top, Verde on the left, Signal on the right. Pure opaque black field, full bleed, the cube filling the frame.
note: Provenance recorded after the fact. The brief is the one on record, not necessarily the one that produced these pixels.
